about: Measured envelopes for every property the hand animates, in the toolkit/schema/move.schema.json shape, plus the composition rules above them. One entry per property, because validate-plan.mjs matches the first entry with a property's name. Durations are in the timing unit (62.5 ms, a frame and a half); 0 units is a zero-duration step, which is how this hand changes most things. references/grammar.md says the same in prose; change both together.

source_moves: select-handles glide (6 f)
cursor hops (4 to 10 f)
endcard-typeon lockup slide (17 f, reveal)
chromatic-title line slide (2.01 s)
camera-rig drift (20 f)
giant-type-pass pan (1.09 W)
primitives.notes: Travel is either short and exact (handles, pointer, a lockup sliding to centre) or giant and cropped by the frame (the pass). Nothing drifts across a held graphic frame except the camera. Every sampled position is held on the 16 fps cadence.

source_moves: giant-word-rise (8 f, 0.67 H)
giant-type-pass rise and later words (29 f)
camera tilt (13 f, 0.06 H)
cursor hops
primitives.notes: Giant words rise from below the frame and are cropped by it; words never fall in from above. A staggered baseline is held, or settles in one frame (baseline-settle), never bounces.

source_moves: camera push x1.10 (12 f)
push-soft x1.34 and push-hard x1.47 (13 f)
pull-back x0.407 (35 f)
pull-settle x0.82 (13 f)
type-fill-echo creep +3 percent (1.75 s)
steps x1.29, x1.994, x2 in one frame
primitives.notes: Two kinds only: a camera move on a picture (log-space scale, 8 to 23 units, ratio 0.41 to 1.47) or a zero-duration step on type or a tile (ratio 1.15 to 2.0). Type never scales smoothly except the 3 percent creep of a held line.

source_moves: chromatic plate crossfades (2 to 3 f)
type ghosting to 0.15 behind a lifted subject (4 f)
cross-dissolve of an edited colour (2 f)
primitives.notes: Things appear and vanish on a single picture. Fades longer than four frames are outside the hand, and no entrance fades in.

source_moves: genre-word-card tracking snap from 0.70 to 1.27 of set width (6 f)
crop-select tracking opening to 0.19 to 0.3 em on a grow step
primitives.notes: A word lands crowded or spread and snaps to its set spacing with the handles; tracking opens in one step as a selection grows.

source_moves: card-wipe window widening in single steps
giant-type-pass whiteness edge sweep (14 f)
radial bloom of the picture behind the pass
type-fill-echo fill appearing in one picture
primitives.notes: Windows open in steps; only the white edge of the pass and the bloom sweep continuously.

source_moves: crop-select grow steps (a creep then a two-picture jump, 15 to 17 f)
endcard-typeon handle box growing per word
primitives.notes: A selected picture grows by revealing more of itself, never by stretching. The measured per-step curves live in crop-select.

source_moves: crop-select grow steps
lockup arriving in the accent then turning ink (1 picture)
mark faint to white to black (single pictures)
giant pass turning white where the picture lands
primitives.notes: Colour changes are steps between token colours.

source_moves: icon-tile accent to pale accent in one step
selection chip pressed to ink
subject brightened about 15 percent for two frames on lift-out
relight bloom peaking and settling over 4 f
primitives.notes: Blur is a fixed property of a plate, never animated. Brightness flashes are one to four frames.
Nothing designed rotates. The pointer's lean is drawn inside the cursor block, and the camera's measured roll belongs to real footage only.
No 3D turns; planes in photographs are mapped by homography (billboard), not rotated.

composition.cadence: Pictures update 16 times a second inside 24 fps: frame f with f mod 3 = 2 repeats frame f - 1 (the end card runs on the other phase). Every block samples its motion on this cadence; footage and real camera moves run on ones.
composition.entrances: Hard cut or one-picture appearance; no fades, no slides onto a still frame except the camera and the lockup slide.
composition.exits: Hard cut, a single-picture vanish, or carried by the next block (shared pan, print into card, grow into full bleed).
composition.holds: About half of every graphic card is a held frame. A held statement lasts 28 frames; the end card holds about 3 s. A hold is never stretched past its block's duration range.
composition.grounds: Paper beats are calm and photographic beats carry the energy; a piece alternates them.
composition.energy: A slow burn with three swells, each higher than the last, separated by near-still graphic beats, and a still ending (templates/film-arc.json).
composition.eye_path: Type sits centred on its ink; the selection frames what matters; giant type runs off the frame edges and is read by its first letters.
composition.copy: One word per half-second card, two or three words per imperative, four to six words for a held statement, one sentence on the end card.
composition.scale: A longer or shorter piece changes the number of items inside elastic beats, never the holds.
composition.novel: A new move is legal when every primitive it drives is inside its envelope and every rule above holds; mark it novel in the plan with a grammar note naming its primitives.
